# ProofPack — technical report template

Status: UNFILLED. Replace each pending field with actual evidence or an explicit limitation. Do not submit this template as measured results.

## Problem, users and scope

Describe the actual packing workflow studied, who participated and which benefit is measured. State one business, invited desktop operators and supported physical recipes. If only synthetic/printable fixtures were used, say so here and in the abstract.

## Architecture and implementation

Include the current diagram, OpenCV substantive functions/build (E02), AWS deployment receipt (E03), state/agent/data boundaries, auth and retention. Record exact commit/artifact/config/model versions. Explain how a visual finding changes the next tool/action with E04.

## Evaluation

Dataset manifest/hash and permissions: PENDING. Physical/synthetic counts: PENDING. Operators/sessions: PENDING. Baselines/budgets: PENDING. Metrics with denominators/uncertainty: PENDING. Raw result links: PENDING. Failed cases and exclusions: PENDING. Learning ablation: PENDING. Optional COOL output-equivalent workload comparison: PENDING or NOT ATTEMPTED.

## Responsibility and limitations

Describe unknown properties, camera spoof boundary, observation sampling/expiry, unsupported objects and human checking. Explain incidents, security/privacy/restore evidence, cost and absent evidence. Claim neither certification nor a proven business moat.

## Reproduce and judge access

Pin dependencies and platform, provide actual build/deploy/test commands and sanitized fixtures, explain expected outputs and failure handling, supply tested endpoint/access or an arranged live demo, and link the <=5-minute video. Include data/model/code/media attribution and rights. Record clean-session access verification.

## Evidence and claim register

Include applicable W01–W26 coverage, persona/role variants and T01–T58 child-case manifests with actual outcomes. Disclose BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLICABLE cases and reasons/configuration, physical origin, independence/conflicts, reference/deletion limits and any failed timing/authority boundary. Scope each claim to the actual tested mode/environment; synthetic evidence never satisfies physical beta gates.

For each material claim: exact statement, evidence ID/artifact, tested population/environment/version, result, limitation and reviewer. Missing evidence means omit or label the claim as proposed. Include actual submission receipt only after a successful authorized submission.
